b5e7965a0d8a50311cec7b7ad229399d7c593634: The Champagny-en-Vanoise ski area, with its 225 km of runs, offers a fine choice for every type of skier: large enough not to go round in circles for a week, yet compact enough to find your favourite sectors easily. The 77 lifts make it possible to chain descents without long queues. Champagny-en-Vanoise's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-maintained green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for learning to ski with children. As for snow, Champagny-en-Vanoise is in a strong position with its summit at 3250 m: even in capricious winters, the upper runs hold up well until April. The village at 1250 m is also well placed to offer comfortable conditions from the middle of December. The budget for a stay in Champagny-en-Vanoise is clearly high: 72€ for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It's the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short: Champagny-en-Vanoise is one of those rare resorts that combines a real village, a sincerely family-friendly atmosphere and runs suited to everyone. It's hard to have a bad stay here.
